# Faroe Islands

[global-law](../) / Faroe Islands

faroe-islands-law holds the current text of all 444 løgtingslógir, 882 kunngerðir and 3 løgtingslógarkunngerðir that logir.fo listed as in force on 2026-10-29, including Stýrisskipanarlógin and Revsilógin, and 5 provisions checked match logir.fo word for word. It is current text only, has missed the acts published since 2026-10-29, and holds no case law. The Danish framework acts (Hjemmestyreloven, Overtagelsesloven) are only in denmark-law, and the retsplejelov for Færøerne is held nowhere except as an empty stub.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
